# Getting help

- **Email:** [tuhin@almanac.bar](mailto:tuhin@almanac.bar). Say what you
  were doing, what you expected and what happened; a screenshot helps.
- **Guide:** [almanac.bar/guide](https://almanac.bar/guide), also in
  [docs/](../docs/README.md). Most setup questions are answered in
  [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
- **Found a bug?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/trulytuhin/almanac-crm/issues/new/choose).
- **Security problem?** Please don't post it publicly. See
  [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).
